summaryLinesEn: “What we’re seeing, for example, with computer-aided engineering, is that you can actually identify ahead of time which are non-essential parameters and you don’t run the simulation, thereby reducing the total simulation time,” she said.
The metric that matters is shifting from peak performance to time to discovery.

Researchers need more compute than any single site can provide, and cloud providers are now pitching AI agents as the layer that ties scattered resources together, according to Annie Ma-Weaver (pictured, left), head of high-performance computing product at Google Cloud, a unit of Google LLC.

Google Cloud brings AI agents to the supercomputing bottleneck

High-performance computing, or HPC, is merging with artificial intelligence faster than many research teams can adapt. Compute capacity is hard to get, and workloads now run across clouds and on-premises clusters. The metric that matters is shifting from peak performance to time to discovery.

That shift is on full display as supercomputing and AI converge at SC26 in Chicago. Researchers need more compute than any single site can provide, and cloud providers are now pitching AI agents as the layer that ties scattered resources together, according to Annie Ma-Weaver (pictured, left), head of high-performance computing product at Google Cloud, a unit of Google LLC.

articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning (FFT). This post explores when FFT outperforms LoRA across key benchmarks, examines the spectral properties of model weight matrices behind the quality gap, shares practical hyperparameter tuning guidelines, and shows how to get started.
articles.titleEn: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Serverless Model Customization on SageMaker AI lets data scientists and machine learning (ML) engineers focus on model fine-tuning without managing infrastructure or GPU capacity planning.

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have emerged as a practical solution for fine-tuning LLMs to downstream tasks, reducing GPU capacity requirements by updating only a small subset of LLM parameters.
Figure 4: Serverless model customization job with training metrics tracked in MLflow Switching from Full Fine-Tuning to LoRA requires only one change: set TrainingType.FULL to TrainingType.LORA .

sourceContent.headline: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning (FFT). This post explores when FFT outperforms LoRA across key benchmarks, examines the spectral properties of model weight matrices behind the quality gap, shares practical hyperparameter tuning guidelines, and shows how to get started.
paragraphs: Serverless Model Customization on SageMaker AI lets data scientists and machine learning (ML) engineers focus on model fine-tuning without managing infrastructure or GPU capacity planning.

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have emerged as a practical solution for fine-tuning LLMs to downstream tasks, reducing GPU capacity requirements by updating only a small subset of LLM parameters.
Figure 4: Serverless model customization job with training metrics tracked in MLflow Switching from Full Fine-Tuning to LoRA requires only one change: set TrainingType.FULL to TrainingType.LORA .

Fine-tuning is the process of continuing to train a pretrained large language model (LLM) on a company’s own data so it adapts to a specific domain, task, or style rather than relying on general-purpose knowledge alone. For businesses, the value is twofold. A fine-tuned model delivers measurably better accuracy on domain-specific work while reducing costs: a smaller specialized model can match or exceed a frontier model on your task at a fraction of the per-token inference price. Those savings compound across millions of requests. Fine-tuning has therefore become an essential process for businesses looking to get more value from LLMs at lower costs.

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have emerged as a practical solution for fine-tuning LLMs to downstream tasks, reducing GPU capacity requirements by updating only a small subset of LLM parameters. LoRA aims to strike a balance between efficiency and expressiveness, however, the low-rank nature of the weight update inherently limits the representation power of LoRA fine-tuned models, potentially compromising performance on complex tasks. This trade-off hampers the ability of LoRA methods to capture complex patterns needed for diverse tasks. To address these challenges, Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) updates model parameters simultaneously, overcoming the low-rank limitations so LLMs can fully absorb complex domain-specific knowledge.

Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) , so you can achieve superior model quality without managing infrastructure. There is no GPU provisioning, cluster setup, or distributed-training configuration required. In this post, we explore when and where FFT consistently outperforms LoRA across key benchmarks, examine the spectral properties of model weight matrices that explain this quality gap, provide practical hyperparameter tuning guidelines backed by controlled experiments using SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization, and show you how to get started with FFT on SageMaker AI.

summaryLines: SageMaker AI의 서버리스 모델 사용자 지정을 통해 데이터 과학자와 기계 학습(ML) 엔지니어는 인프라 또는 GPU 용량 계획을 관리하지 않고도 모델 미세 조정에 집중할 수 있음
LoRA(Low-Rank Adaptation)와 같은 매개변수 효율적인 미세 조정(PEFT) 방법은 LLM 매개변수의 작은 하위 집합만 업데이트하여 GPU 용량 요구 사항을 줄이는 다운스트림 작업에 대한 LLM 미세 조정을 위한 실용적인 솔루션으로 등장함
그림 4: MLflow에서 훈련 지표를 추적하는 서버리스 모델 사용자 정의 작업 전체 미세 조정에서 LoRA로 전환하려면 TrainingType.FULL을 TrainingType.LORA로 설정하는 한 가지 변경만 필요함

articles.title: Does a Laptop Powered by Snapdragon Really Last All Week? What to Expect From the HP OmniBook 3 - CNET
articles.descEn: The HP OmniBook 3 with the Snapdragon X processor is rated for up to 41 hours of battery life. Here’s how to stretch each charge.
articles.titleEn: Does a Laptop Powered by Snapdragon Really Last All Week? What to Expect From the HP OmniBook 3 - CNET
summaryLinesEn: Quick Answer: Some professionals may be able to get through a full working week on a single charge with the HP OmniBook 3 with Snapdragon X , which Currys rates at up to 41 hours of battery life.
The HP OmniBook 3 has a secret weapon for power efficiency: the first-generation Snapdragon X (the eight-core X1-26-100) processor.
If you’re putting the laptop away for the whole weekend, shutting it down (or using Hibernate if available, which uses even less power than sleep) can help preserve a charge for Monday morning.

summaryLinesEn: When Dell began planning its portfolio 2.5 years ago, enterprise customers forecast rack power holding at 15 to 20 kilowatts and said they often ran out of power before filling a rack, according to Schmidt.
A single EPYC 9006 server can take 13 legacy machines out of production while cutting the system power needed for cooling by 80 percent, Schmidt noted.
Agentic AI puts the CPU back at center stage as Dell and AMD chase every watt Agentic AI is rewriting the business development playbook for chipmakers and server builders.

articles.title: Memory bottlenecks in AI: How photonics and shared pools help - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Memory bottlenecks leave GPUs idle as inference grows, but photonics and shared HBM pools can cut data movement energy to a quarter of copper.
articles.titleEn: Memory bottlenecks in AI: How photonics and shared pools help - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: AI’s hidden energy tax: More than 80% of scale-up traffic is just memory moving around Memory bottlenecks are emerging as one of the costliest problems in AI infrastructure as inference overtakes training.
More than 80 percent of scale-up network traffic is memory transactions, and a shared pool means much of that data never moves at all, he noted.
Each appliance holds 16 terabytes of HBM and DDR5 memory that servers across multiple racks can share, Mills explained.

summaryLines: AI의 숨겨진 에너지 세금 · 확장 트래픽의 80% 이상이 메모리 주변을 이동하는 메모리 병목 현상은 추론이 훈련을 앞지르면서 AI 인프라에서 가장 비용이 많이 드는 문제 중 하나로 떠오르고 있음
스케일업 네트워크 트래픽의 80% 이상이 메모리 트랜잭션이며, 공유 풀은 해당 데이터의 대부분이 전혀 이동하지 않는다는 것을 의미한다고 그는 지적함
각 어플라이언스는 여러 랙에 걸쳐 서버가 공유할 수 있는 16테라바이트의 HBM 및 DDR5 메모리를 보유하고 있다고 Mills는 설명함

articles.title: Introducing FlowForma Agent Trust: Every AI Agent, Under Control
articles.descEn: FlowForma, the AI and process automation company, today launched FlowForma Agent Trust, an AI agent governance hub that brings oversight to every agent an organization runs, from any platform or vendor. It manages processes, people and agents side by side, holding AI to the same standard as a member of the team: visible, accountable and under control.
articles.titleEn: Introducing FlowForma Agent Trust: Every AI Agent, Under Control
summaryLinesEn: FlowForma Contract runs procurement, contract and tender management, FlowForma Assure speeds up vendor security assessment, and FlowForma Agent Trust governs, monitors and optimizes AI agents.

18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FlowForma , the AI and process automation company, today launched FlowForma Agent Trust , an AI agent governance hub that brings oversight to every agent an organization runs, from any platform or vendor.
FlowForma Agent Trust discovers every AI agent at work in an organization and checks what it delivers against real outcomes, human corrections and cost.

articles.title: Suno now lets you make AI videos for your AI music
articles.descEn: Suno has introduced image and video generation in its latest effort to expand beyond being an AI music platform.
articles.titleEn: Suno now lets you make AI videos for your AI music
summaryLinesEn: From there, users can select which section of the track to use, up to a maximum of 15 seconds, and select a reference image to build the generated video clip.
Suno has introduced image and video generation in its latest effort to expand beyond being an AI music platform.

Visuals also uses its own “Visuals credits” to generate videos and images, which are distinct from the song credits used to make AI music, meaning Suno users will have additional expenses to pay in order to use this new feature.

articles.title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
articles.descEn: Osmo’s smell model is already being used in the fragrance industry. But are medical diagnostics and threat detection a sniff too far?
articles.titleEn: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
summaryLinesEn: A lot of the company’s work has been in creating its own dataset of more than 10 million human labels and 800 million “scent tokens,” which describe the exact molecules and concentrations that go into creating specific odors.

The Gates Foundation, which invested $5 million when Osmo launched, later gave the company a $3.5 million grant to assess molecules that repel disease-carrying insects, and Osmo identified eight substances that were more repellent than DEET.
It says its technology is already being used in the fragrance industry to help brands design and manufacture new scents.

articles.title: Over a Third of Gen Z-ers Rely on AI for Friendship
articles.descEn: Young people who have online-only friends or use AI as a social companion face higher odds of loneliness than those who do not, a new Gallup report reveals.
articles.titleEn: Over a Third of Gen Z-ers Rely on AI for Friendship
summaryLinesEn: In “ Friendship in an Online-Offline World: Digital Life, Connection and Wellbeing ” researchers from public polling firm Gallup and the Digital Wellness Lab at Boston Children’s Hospital found that more than one-third of Gen Z (33 percent) rely on AI for companionship.

While researchers are wary of classifying the report as a permanent shift in how young people form relationships, they say it does signal a growing reliance on AI companionship as part of a pattern of digital social engagement unfolding among Gen Z.

In the US, where state legislators have introduced bills to curb addictive design features, a majority of Americans support banning kids under 16 from using social media, according to a recent Pew Research survey .

localization.title: Z세대의 3분의 1 이상이 우정을 위해 AI에 의존함
summaryLines: 공공 여론 조사 회사인 Gallup과 Boston Children's Hospital의 Digital Wellness Lab의 연구원들은 “온라인-오프라인 세계의 우정 · 디지털 생활, 연결 및 웰빙”에서 Z세대의 3분의 1 이상(33%)이 동료애를 위해 AI에 의존한다는 사실을 발견함
연구자들은 이 보고서를 젊은이들이 관계를 형성하는 방식의 영구적인 변화로 분류하는 것을 경계하지만, 이는 Z세대 사이에 펼쳐지는 디지털 사회적 참여 패턴의 일부로 AI 동반자 관계에 대한 의존도가 높아지고 있음을 의미한다고 말함
최근 퓨 리서치(Pew Research) 조사에 따르면 주 의회가 중독성 있는 디자인 기능을 억제하기 위한 법안을 발의한 미국에서는 미국인 대다수가 16세 미만 어린이의 소셜 미디어 사용 금지를 지지하는 것으로 나타남

articles.title: ‘Just Ridiculous’: A Famed Philosopher Takes on AI Consciousness
articles.descEn: Thomas Nagel has done landmark work on consciousness in nonhumans; this week, he won the million-dollar Berggruen Prize for his contributions to the field. And he has a lot of thoughts on AI.
articles.titleEn: ‘Just Ridiculous’: A Famed Philosopher Takes on AI Consciousness
summaryLinesEn: Over 50 years ago, philosopher Thomas Nagel asked the question, “What Is It Like to Be a Bat?”

We have strong reasons to believe that while there may be consciousness elsewhere in the universe, it would require the appearance of some kind of organism with something analogous to a nervous system.
It’s been 52 years since you wrote “What Is It Like to Be a Bat?,” which has become an iconic paper about understanding consciousness in non-humans.

articles.title: Criminals Have a New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
articles.descEn: Artex and similar penetration testing tools allow newbie hackers to scan targeted systems for vulnerabilities and successfully wage attacks using prompts fed to chatbots.
articles.titleEn: Criminals Have a New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
summaryLinesEn: Over the past year, security researchers have warned that AI agents could vastly speed up cybercriminals’ ability to launch cyberattacks, breach companies , and ultimately steal money, data, or sensitive information from those compromised systems.
Hackers also don’t need to be skilled to use the tools, researchers say, and attacks that would have taken days are completed in just hours.

Pinpointing the number of cybercriminals using Artex and other frameworks isn’t easy; however, thousands of instances of the systems being set up have been exposed to the internet, according to analysis by Censys and the Shadowserver Foundation.

articles.title: OpenAI opens its AI systems to four independent on-site auditors for the first time
articles.descEn: OpenAI is giving four independent audit organizations, including Apollo Research and METR, direct access to unreleased models, source code, and training data for the first time. The embedded reviews are designed to uncover hidden misbehavior and safety gaps. OpenAI can redact or delay reports, so how independent this oversight actually turns out to be remains an open question.

summaryLinesEn: OpenAI and Transluce are also planning an eight-week follow-up review for early 2027.
OpenAI is giving four outside audit organizations direct access to its internal AI systems to investigate safety risks and model behavior on-site.
The company expects some friction early on but is already considering more reviews, including ones focused on company culture and internal processes.

articles.title: Pangram flags 99 percent of an award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but the publisher stands by its author
articles.descEn: The AI detection tool Pangram flags 99 percent of a prize-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but Mexican publisher Almadía is standing by the award after its own review. Pangram also classified over 80 percent of the author's personal texts as machine-written. French publisher Gallimard plans to start screening manuscripts with the tool.
articles.titleEn: Pangram flags 99 percent of an award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but the publisher stands by its author
summaryLinesEn: AI detection tool Pangram flags 99 percent of the award-winning novel "Donde el agua trabaja" by Peruvian author David Silva Rojas as AI-generated.
According to the newspaper El País, Pangram had also attributed more than 80 percent of text from interviews, an essay, and the author's Instagram denial to AI.
Despite these allegations, Mexican publisher Almadía is standing by the award after reviewing documents from the author, according to an essay in The Point Magazine .

articles.title: Remember the frontier AI pause? Chip companies don’t either
articles.descEn: Nvidia and AMD earnings show booming demand. This is why a frontier slowdown might not derail it.
articles.titleEn: Remember the frontier AI pause? Chip companies don’t either
summaryLinesEn: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink AMD rides data center riches to ‘largest and most profitable’ quarter in history Intel says it’s selling every affordable laptop chip it can make Chipmaker AMD, meanwhile, reported its biggest quarter ever earlier this month, with revenue up 45 percent to $13.4 billion .

The people building the most powerful models were warning about what those models might be capable of, and investors were suddenly wondering what would happen to chip demand if the labs eased up on new models.
The impact could show up sooner in orders placed with chip manufacturers like TSMC.

articles.title: Google's AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
articles.descEn: Google's new temporary threads let users have conversations in AI Mode without adding them to their search history or influencing future recommendations.
articles.titleEn: Google's AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
summaryLinesEn: The option could be convenient to use at those times when you start digging deeper into a particular topic via AI Mode and realize that you don’t want the discussion to become a part of your search history because of its personal nature.
Google’s search engine has long offered an incognito mode for all those search queries you don’t want logged or associated with your account.
Now, Google’s AI Mode in Search is getting a similar feature.

articles.title: You can now see and edit what Google Gemini remembers about you - Engadget
articles.descEn: Editing the AI’s memory is one way you can shape its responses.
articles.titleEn: You can now see and edit what Google Gemini remembers about you - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Depending on what you share, Gemini's picture of you can be fairly intimate, which makes the ability to edit the AI's memory all the more important.
The AI isn't able to create any memories unless it can remember and access your inputs, so Keep Activity needs to be on for this to work.

Besides the ability to connect and use other applications and services, a lot of AI assistants' utility comes from their capacity to shape their responses based on what they learn and remember about you.

articles.descEn: The Trump administration announced plans to clamp down on China’s access to AI chips. Apparently, the cheating scandal of the century was the motivation they were missing.
articles.titleEn: America’s AI Chip War Is Heating Up in the Dumbest Possible Ways
summaryLinesEn: According to Bloomberg, roughly 50,000 of the estimated 136,000 AI chips Megaspeed imported into Malaysia and Indonesia in 2024 and 2025 weren't accounted for in Nvidia's initial inventory checks.

The bureau's job only got harder as the Biden administration introduced successive rounds of increasingly complex restrictions, scrambling to tighten the rules as chipmakers found increasingly elaborate ways to get around them.

(A White House spokesperson previously told WIRED that the new rule would “crack down on the smuggling of advanced US SI chips” and “help ensure that America’s most advanced chips go first to US SI innovators, not Chinese shell companies.”)

localization.title: 미국의 AI 칩 전쟁이 가능한 가장 멍청한 방식으로 가열되고 있음
summaryLines: Bloomberg에 따르면 Megaspeed가 2024년과 2025년에 말레이시아와 인도네시아로 수입한 약 136,000개의 AI 칩 중 약 50,000개가 Nvidia의 초기 재고 확인에서 제외됨
Biden 행정부가 점점 더 복잡해지는 제한 사항을 연속적으로 도입하고, 칩 제조업체들이 이를 피할 수 있는 점점 더 정교한 방법을 찾으면서 규칙을 강화하기 위해 안간힘을 쓰면서 국의 업무는 더욱 어려워졌음
(백악관 대변인은 이전에 WIRED에 새로운 규정이 “첨단 미국 SI 칩의 밀수를 단속하고” “미국의 가장 진보된 칩이 중국 쉘 회사가 아닌 미국 SI 혁신가에게 먼저 전달되도록 보장하는 데 도움이 될 것”이라고 WIRED에 말했습니다.)

articles.title: Even His Own Officials Don’t Think Trump’s China Trip Will Lead to Progress on AI
articles.descEn: Fallout from the Nvidia scandal has made any negotiations around AI difficult, officials say.
articles.titleEn: Even His Own Officials Don’t Think Trump’s China Trip Will Lead to Progress on AI
summaryLinesEn: While Trump has sought to forge friendlier economic relations with China, the administration this week announced it would move forward with a new rule clamping down on China's ability to remotely access US-made AI chips in foreign data centers.

Back in September, the Trump administration moved to set up an AI incident hotline between Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese vice premier He Lifeng to account for situations just like this one.
Part of the reason progress hasn’t been made yet is due to differing views on what the biggest risks are with AI—and both nations have different incentives on making incidents public, officials say.

summaryLines: 트럼프 대통령은 중국과 보다 우호적인 경제 관계를 구축하려고 노력했지만, 이번 주 행정부는 외국 데이터 센터에서 미국산 AI 칩에 원격으로 접근하는 중국의 능력을 단속하는 새로운 규정을 추진할 것이라고 발표함
지난 9월 트럼프 행정부는 이와 같은 상황을 설명하기 위해 스콧 베센트(Scott Bessent) 재무장관과 허리펑(He Lifeng) 중국 부총리 사이에 AI 사건 핫라인을 개설하기로 함
아직 진전이 이루어지지 않은 이유 중 하나는 AI의 가장 큰 위험이 무엇인지에 대한 서로 다른 견해 때문이며, 두 국가 모두 사건을 공개하는 데 서로 다른 인센티브를 갖고 있다고 관계자는 말함

articles.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth new Gemini model in a month
articles.descEn: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a new frontier model built for software development, knowledge work, and science. It handles text, images, video, audio, and PDFs with a context window of one million tokens. At $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, Neon is priced above previous Gemini 4 models.
articles.titleEn: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth new Gemini model in a month
summaryLinesEn: The model is live today through the API at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, above Carbon and Argon's introductory rate of $2/$10 (doubling to $4/$20 on December 1 ) and twice the price of Hydrogen at $1.50/$7.50.
It handles text, images, video, audio, and PDFs, with support for Computer Use , code execution, file search, and grounding via Google Search and Maps.
It's also Google's fourth new Gemini 4 model in four weeks.

articles.title: What is Nvidia without AI’s sugar daddy in charge?
articles.descEn: While the Branch Nvidians try to reinstate Jensen Huang, Collette Kress, Nvidia’s acting CEO, has to lead the company. The earnings call hinted at how.
articles.titleEn: What is Nvidia without AI’s sugar daddy in charge?
summaryLinesEn: For instance, if Elon Musk is telling the truth , then Jensen Huang (the former CEO of Nvidia, a company with a market cap of about $3 trillion) has been making deals that were “a handshake with Jensen” with suppliers — “not a written contract,” Musk wrote.
But after listening to Nvidia’s first earnings call with its new CEO, Colette Kress, I do think something may have shifted.
This is an important thing, though — as SemiAnalysis noted in its bizarrely conspiratorial post on the situation, Nvidia is successful because it has choked off the supply chain .

articles.title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
articles.descEn: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.
articles.titleEn: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
summaryLinesEn: Speaking at The New York Times DealBook Summit on Wednesday, the tech executive argued that the shift to an agentic web could change which companies pay others for traffic and for transactions, similar to how the transition from web portals like Yahoo to search engines like Google did years ago.
“And if you were monetizing ads because of the eyeballs, you now have to probably get down to essentially maybe CPC [cost-per-click] wins; maybe it’s more transactional,” he continued.
“The current aggregators who have a business model which was for the human web will get, in some sense, reshuffled,” said Nadella.

paragraphs: Speaking at The New York Times DealBook Summit on Wednesday, the tech executive argued that the shift to an agentic web could change which companies pay others for traffic and for transactions, similar to how the transition from web portals like Yahoo to search engines like Google did years ago.
“And if you were monetizing ads because of the eyeballs, you now have to probably get down to essentially maybe CPC [cost-per-click] wins; maybe it’s more transactional,” he continued.
“The current aggregators who have a business model which was for the human web will get, in some sense, reshuffled,” said Nadella.

“The current aggregators who have a business model which was for the human web will get, in some sense, reshuffled,” said Nadella. “And if you were monetizing ads because of the eyeballs, you now have to probably get down to essentially maybe CPC [cost-per-click] wins; maybe it’s more transactional,” he continued. “And so if you don’t accept the agent, somebody else will.”

The discussion turned to Amazon and its decision to block AI agents from accessing its retail website, preventing them from browsing its catalog and making purchases on behalf of their users. Nadella suggested that companies trying to protect their existing business models could lose out to others that are more willing to embrace the AI agents. For instance, if Amazon continues blocking agents, another shopping platform such as Shopify, could allow them, and gain an advantage.

sourceContent.headline: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is 'unpatchable'
sourceContent.description: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.
paragraphs: In other words: The smartification of the economy, in which much of the world’s “dumb” devices were hooked up to the internet, is now causing tremendous headaches.
“The patch [now] needs to go instantly from being available to being patched in production, because it’s being exploited in the wild, right?
“Remember, there is a lot of stuff in our critical infrastructure that’s unpatchable,” Nadella said.

During his appearance at The New York Times’ DealBook Summit on Wednesday, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella lamented the fact that a lot of America’s software systems — including those governing everyday hardware and transportation systems — suffer from unfixable software vulnerabilities that, in the age of AI-aided cyberattacks, are just waiting to be exploited.

“Remember, there is a lot of stuff in our critical infrastructure that’s unpatchable,” Nadella said. “I mean, think about all the firmware and the chillers [a cooling device often used in data centers] and the HVAC systems everywhere else. So all of that, by the way, they’re on the internet.”

articles.title: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
summaryLinesEn: On the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, Rumble-2-Flash averages a 6.96% error rate across Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Dutch and English.

Runs anywhere : native support in 🤗 Transformers and vLLM, no custom code Output control : numbers as digits or words, fillers, verbatim repeats, forced language Extremely fast : an hour of audio in about half a second, with over 7,000 RTFx on full batches Holds up on real phone calls : on par with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) on a 302-hour call-centre benchmark audio accepts a local path, a URL, a NumPy array, or a list of these.
It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.

localization.title: Rumble-2-Flash: 40개 이상의 언어를 위한 개방형 0.5B 음성 모델
summaryLines: Open ASR Leaderboard 다국어 트랙에서 Rumble-2-Flash는 중국어, 독일어, 프랑스어, 이탈리아어, 스페인어, 포르투갈어, 힌디어, 네덜란드어 및 영어에서 평균 6.96%의 오류율을 기록함

어디서나 실행 가능 · 🤗 Transformers 및 vLLM에서 기본 지원, 사용자 지정 코드 없음 출력 제어 · 숫자 또는 단어로 된 숫자, 필러, 축어적 반복, 강제 언어 매우 빠름 · 약 0.5초 만에 1시간의 오디오, 전체 배치에서 7,000개 이상의 RTFx 포함 실제 전화 통화 유지 · 302시간 콜 센터 벤치마크에서 NVIDIA의 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe(30B)와 동등 오디오는 로컬을 허용함 · 경로, URL, NumPy 배열 또는 이들의 목록임
40개 이상의 언어에 대한 0.5B 매개변수 음성 인식 모델로 크기가 3~60배인 모델과 경쟁함

articles.title: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
summaryLinesEn: To try it, install Transformers from that PR: Then, moving from OLMoE to the real target, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: That repo holds the output of the project's conversion script : the dense weights, the experts quantized to 3 bits, and the n-gram table.

I ran all of them on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on one A10G (24 GB), with plenty of RAM, and Harry Mellor reran vLLM with better flags: Offloading only the experts doubles vLLM's speed, and FP8 helps on top (half the bytes per expert, more of the model on the GPU). vLLM's other offload backend, which copies groups of layers ahead of time, ran under 1 tok/s.
I had a dual boot with Ubuntu, but their games ended up taking most of the two terabytes of disk.

articles.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
articles.descEn: AlphaGenome 2 is our next-generation DNA sequence model that bridges single-cell biology and human genetics, predicting how variants affect human cell types.
articles.titleEn: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
summaryLinesEn: We trained AlphaGenome 2 on both bulk and single-cell data from human and mouse samples, including over 107 million individual cell profiles.
We expanded its reach with AlphaGenome Atlas , a platform containing predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter changes in the human genome.

AlphaGenome 2 extends enhancer-gene mapping to primary human cell types — such as brain astrocytes, which support and protect neurons — helping researchers connect regulatory variants to their target genes in the specific cells where disease unfolds.

articles.title: How we raised Databricks cluster rate limits by 7.5× | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Learn how adaptive concurrency limits helped Databricks raise cluster-creation request-rate limits by 7.5× while protecting long-running workflows.
articles.titleEn: How we raised Databricks cluster rate limits by 7.5× | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Conservative limits turned away customer requests despite spare capacity, yet kept accepting requests when our services or dependencies, such as cloud providers, slowed down.
Engineers manually lowered limits to shed load during incidents and raised them again after recovery.

In this post, we'll explore why fixed request-rate limits can fall short for these long-running operations, how adaptive concurrency limits help, and what we learned applying them to cluster creation for Databricks classic compute.

articles.title: The Future of the Global Jewish Population
articles.descEn: The world’s Jewish population is projected to become increasingly concentrated in Israel over the coming decades.
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Global Jewish Population
summaryLinesEn: If recent demographic trends continue, Israel will be home to 62% of the global Jewish population in 2070, up from 46% in 2020.

57 At the same time, because the global Jewish population is expected to grow at a slower pace than other religious groups analyzed in this study, Jews will make up a slightly smaller percentage of all the people in the world in 2070 (0.17%) than they did in 2020 (0.19%).
Because of these divergent trends in the U.S. and Israel, the share of the global Jewish population living in America is projected to shrink, from 39% in 2020 to 26% in 2070.

articles.title: The Future of the Global Muslim Population
articles.descEn: Between 2020 and 2070, the world’s Muslim population is expected to grow more than all other religious groups combined.
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Global Muslim Population
summaryLinesEn: According to Pew Research Center’s projections, the global Muslim population will grow in number by 80% between 2020 and 2070, while the global non-Muslim population will increase by 11%.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

The Muslim population will grow by 9 million in the United States but will still account for a relatively small percentage of the country’s total population (4%). 54 countries and territories will have Muslim majorities, including 35 places where Muslims will make up at least 90% of the population.

articles.title: The Future of Religion in Europe
articles.descEn: A slim majority of Europeans are projected to be Christian in 2070, while the percentage who are Muslim will double to 13%.
articles.titleEn: The Future of Religion in Europe
summaryLinesEn: The study anticipates that Europe’s Christian population will decrease by more than a third in absolute numbers in coming decades, from 505 million in 2020 to 324 million in 2070.
Due to lower fertility rates and an older population than other regions, Europe is the only major region in the world that we project will have a smaller total population in 2070 than it did in 2020.

In Europe, Christians will decline by at least 5 percentage points as a share of the population in 30 countries, while the Muslim share of the population will rise by 5 points or more in 21 countries.

articles.title: Islam Will Soon Be the World’s Largest Religion, but Christianity Will Keep Growing Too
articles.descEn: Muslims will outnumber Christians by 2035, driven by higher fertility, but both groups are projected to keep growing in the decades ahead.
articles.titleEn: Islam Will Soon Be the World’s Largest Religion, but Christianity Will Keep Growing Too
summaryLinesEn: The United States had the world’s largest Christian population in 2020, and it is expected to witness the greatest decline in the number of Christians, dropping from 217 million in 2020 to 174 million in 2070.
Despite this shift, Muslim population growth will not slow the rise of the Christian population.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

sourceContent.headline: Islam Will Soon Be the World’s Largest Religion, but Christianity Will Keep Growing Too
sourceContent.description: Muslims will outnumber Christians by 2035, driven by higher fertility, but both groups are projected to keep growing in the decades ahead.
paragraphs: The United States had the world’s largest Christian population in 2020, and it is expected to witness the greatest decline in the number of Christians, dropping from 217 million in 2020 to 174 million in 2070.
Despite this shift, Muslim population growth will not slow the rise of the Christian population.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

Today, Christians are the largest religious group in the world and Muslims are the second largest. But that will change by 2035, when Muslims will surpass Christians in population, according to new Pew Research Center projections.

Despite this shift, Muslim population growth will not slow the rise of the Christian population. Both groups will see their numbers increase in the decades ahead. The Muslim population is simply growing at a faster pace than the Christian population.
This analysis takes a closer look at the factors driving the growth of these two groups.

articles.title: Two-Thirds of Americans Disapprove of Trump’s Handling of the Russia-Ukraine War
articles.descEn: Around four-in-ten Americans say Trump is favoring Russia too much in the conflict, while a much smaller share (7%) say he is favoring Ukraine too much.
articles.titleEn: Two-Thirds of Americans Disapprove of Trump’s Handling of the Russia-Ukraine War
summaryLinesEn: Around four-in-ten Americans say Trump is favoring Russia too much in the conflict, while a much smaller share (7%) say he is favoring Ukraine too much.

As has been the case for most of the last few years, about half of adults (49%) say the U.S. has a responsibility to help Ukraine defend itself from Russia. 34% of Republicans continue to say the U.S. has this responsibility.
The share of Americans saying Trump is favoring Russia too much (39%) is 6 percentage points higher than in August 2025.

paragraphs: Around four-in-ten Americans say Trump is favoring Russia too much in the conflict, while a much smaller share (7%) say he is favoring Ukraine too much.

As has been the case for most of the last few years, about half of adults (49%) say the U.S. has a responsibility to help Ukraine defend itself from Russia. 34% of Republicans continue to say the U.S. has this responsibility.
The share of Americans saying Trump is favoring Russia too much (39%) is 6 percentage points higher than in August 2025.

Two-thirds of Americans now say they disapprove of President Donald Trump’s handling of the war between Russia and Ukraine, while three-in-ten say they approve, according to a Pew Research Center survey of 10,247 adults conducted Nov. 9-15.
These findings come as Trump prepares to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at a summit in China on Thursday.

Around four-in-ten Americans say Trump is favoring Russia too much in the conflict, while a much smaller share (7%) say he is favoring Ukraine too much. Another 21% say Trump is striking the right balance, and 33% say they are not sure.

articles.descEn: Results from a survey of 1,260 social scientists about AI and coding agent use.
articles.titleEn: Coding agents in the social sciences
summaryLinesEn: But Figure 4 shows that the most common use, for both coding agent users and others, is for coding up analysis of quantitative data: 97% of coding agent users and 77% of other AI users report using it to generate code.
The human sciences are shifting: for the first time, core research tasks can be handed off to machines.
These tools could accelerate science and make it more daring: fast research execution should mean cheap and plentiful discovery.

articles.titleEn: Introducing the Anthropic Economic Index
summaryLinesEn: The main findings from the Economic Index’s first paper are: Today, usage is concentrated in software development and technical writing tasks.
Economics Apr 22, 2026 Announcing the Anthropic Economic Index Survey In the coming years, AI systems will have a major impact on the ways people work.

We’d therefore expect AI to be adopted selectively for different tasks across different occupations, and that analyzing tasks—in addition to jobs as a whole—would give us a fuller picture of how AI is being integrated into the economy.

articles.title: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
articles.descEn: The second update from the Anthropic Economic Index on how people are using AI.
articles.titleEn: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
summaryLinesEn: Today, we’re releasing our second research report from the Index, covering usage data on Claude.ai following the launch of Claude 3.7 Sonnet —our newest and most capable model with strengths in agentic coding and a new “extended thinking” mode.

Last month, we launched the Anthropic Economic Index —a new initiative where we’re regularly releasing data and research aimed at understanding AI's effects on labor markets and the economy over time.

While this increase in coding usage was expected due to Claude 3.7 Sonnet’s improved scores on coding benchmarks, the increase in these other categories could reflect either ongoing diffusion of AI throughout the economy, novel applications of coding to those domains, or unexpected capability improvements in the model.

localization.title: 경제 지수 · Claude 3.7 Sonnet의 통찰력
summaryLines: 오늘 우리는 에이전트 코딩과 새로운 "확장 사고" 모드의 강점을 갖춘 최신이자 가장 유능한 모델인 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 출시 이후 Claude.ai의 사용 데이터를 다루는 Index의 두 번째 연구 보고서를 발표함
지난 달 우리는 시간이 지남에 따라 AI가 노동 시장과 경제에 미치는 영향을 이해하기 위한 데이터와 연구를 정기적으로 공개하는 새로운 이니셔티브인 인류 경제 지수(Anthropic Economic Index)를 시작함
코딩 사용량의 이러한 증가는 Claude 3.7 Sonnet의 코딩 벤치마크 점수 향상으로 인해 예상되었지만, 이러한 다른 범주의 증가는 경제 전반에 걸친 AI의 지속적인 확산, 해당 영역에 대한 새로운 코딩 적용 또는 모델의 예상치 못한 기능 향상을 반영할 수 있음

articles.title: How people use Claude for support and advice
articles.descEn: Only 2.9% of Claude conversations involve emotional support, advice, or companionship. We share research on affective use and how we're building safeguards.
articles.titleEn: How people use Claude for support and advice
summaryLinesEn: Takeaway: Affective conversations are a small but meaningful slice of Claude usage (2.9%), with most people primarily using AI for work tasks and content creation.
Takeaway: People tend to shift towards slightly more positive emotional expressions while talking to Claude.

Less than 10% of coaching or counseling conversations involve Claude resisting user requests, and when it does, it's typically for safety reasons (for example, refusing to provide dangerous weight loss advice or support self-harm).

summaryLines: 시사점 · 감동적인 대화는 Claude 사용(2.9%)의 작지만 의미 있는 부분이며, 대부분의 사람들은 주로 업무 작업과 콘텐츠 제작에 AI를 사용함
요약 · 사람들은 Claude와 대화하는 동안 약간 더 긍정적인 감정 표현을 하는 경향이 있음
코칭 또는 상담 대화의 10% 미만에는 Claude가 사용자 요청에 저항하는 내용이 포함되어 있으며, 그럴 경우 일반적으로 안전상의 이유(예 · 위험한 체중 감량 조언 제공 거부 또는 자해 지원 거부)임

articles.title: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
articles.descEn: A randomized trial with 52 developers found AI assistance lowered comprehension scores, except when used for explanations rather than delegation.
articles.titleEn: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
summaryLinesEn: In a randomized controlled trial, we examined 1) how quickly software developers picked up a new skill (in this case, a Python library) with and without AI assistance; and 2) whether using AI made them less likely to understand the code they’d just written.
Though preliminary, these results suggest important considerations as companies transition to a greater ratio of AI-written to human-written code.

Here, AI creates a potential tension: as coding grows more automated and speeds up work, humans will still need the skills to catch errors, guide output, and ultimately provide oversight for AI deployed in high-stakes environments.

localization.title: AI 지원이 코딩 기술 형성에 미치는 영향
summaryLines: 무작위 대조 시험에서 우리는 1) 소프트웨어 개발자가 AI 지원 유무에 관계없이 얼마나 빨리 새로운 기술(이 경우 Python 라이브러리)을 습득했는지; 2) AI를 사용하면 방금 작성한 코드를 이해할 가능성이 낮아졌는지 여부
비록 예비적이긴 하지만, 이러한 결과는 기업이 AI로 작성한 코드와 사람이 작성한 코드의 비율을 더 높이는 방식으로 전환함에 따라 중요한 고려 사항을 제시함
여기에서 AI는 잠재적인 긴장감을 조성함 · 코딩이 더욱 자동화되고 작업 속도가 빨라짐에 따라 인간에게는 여전히 오류를 포착하고 출력을 안내하며 궁극적으로 고위험 환경에 배포된 AI를 감독하는 기술이 필요함

articles.title: Google for Mexico: Technology impact that goes beyond business
articles.descEn: Google for Mexico 2026 highlights how AI and local partnerships drive economic growth and social impact. See the latest innovations and report results.
articles.titleEn: Google for Mexico: Technology impact that goes beyond business
summaryLinesEn: Sebastian Valverde, Country Managing Director for Google Mexico, reports that our tools contributed 382 billion pesos to the local economy in 2025.

articles.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Dharma-AI on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
summaryLinesEn: So we took 272 real supervised fine-tuning (SFT) jobs from our production pool of NVIDIA H200 GPUs, about 7,382 GPU-hours in total, and compared analytical estimates against learned predictors.
A CatBoost regressor that only sees information available before dispatch reaches R² = 0.98, with a mean absolute error of 1.71 h and a median error of 0.51 h in 5-fold cross-validation.
The short version: the usual FLOP-based estimate explains little of what we observed (R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41 h).

articles.title: How Stretto built an AI voice agent with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Stretto replaced its web-form lead capture with Tara, an AI voice agent built on Amazon Nova 2 Sonic that conducts bankruptcy intake interviews by phone and qualifies leads. See how Stretto, the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center, and CI&T designed the voice architecture, validated it for sensitive conversations, and moved it to production.
articles.titleEn: How Stretto built an AI voice agent with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: When a caller dials the Bankruptcy.com number, Tara picks up, introduces herself, and guides the caller through a structured conversation.

The team chose Amazon Nova 2 Sonic over the previous voice solution for three reasons: Cost: Stretto reports a 95 percent reduction in per-minute voice cost compared to its previous solution, based on Amazon Bedrock on-demand pricing in us-east-1 as of April 2026.

Stretto used Twilio for telephony because Tara’s intake is fully automated, with no human agents taking calls, and because Stretto wanted a direct integration with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic that kept its existing AWS backend in place.

articles.title: Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to private APIs in a hub-and-spoke network with centralized inspection | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Many enterprises run a centralized network model: one account owns every VPC and a central firewall inspects all traffic. This post shows a tested pattern for connecting Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to private APIs and MCP servers in that model, with the VPC Lattice resource gateway in the network account so every hop crosses the firewall.
articles.titleEn: Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to private APIs in a hub-and-spoke network with centralized inspection | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Share one resource configuration per backend with the AgentCore account through AWS RAM.
Self-managed mode, as documented, places it in subnets with direct access to the backend, which fits environments that do not require inspection between the Gateway and the tool.
Agents that call internal REST APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, must meet the same two requirements.

articles.title: How Social Department built culture-aware video discovery | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Social Department, an AI operating system for entertainment marketing, worked with TrackIt and AWS to build QuickSearch: single-action queries that surface shareable scenes, quotable lines, memeable frames, and trend-aligned moments across large video libraries, using TwelveLabs models on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon OpenSearch Serverless.
articles.titleEn: How Social Department built culture-aware video discovery | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Quotable Quotes finds punchy, quotable dialogue capped at short clip lengths, weighting up lines that have demonstrably circulated where that signal is available for the title.

TwelveLabs’ Marengo 3.0 and Pegasus 1.2 models on Amazon Bedrock provide the scene-level video reasoning the pipeline builds on.

articles.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
articles.descEn: A Blog post by RadixArk on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
summaryLinesEn: We trained it on long-horizon agent tasks with sessions up to 1M tokens, with just 1,200 curated tasks in 18 days on 144 H200 GPUs.

The learning runs on our internal training backend, which is built for agent training: each step learns from a handful of very long sessions, some as long as 1M tokens, folded into multiple trajectories via harness summarization. 57% lower training cost.
Each attempt gets up to 1.5 hours in a sandbox, with more than 100 tool calls and more than 256K output tokens.

articles.title: How Salesforce is advancing global-scale model serving with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Salesforce uses the cross-Region inference router in Amazon SageMaker AI to turn fragmented Regional capacity into reliable model serving. Salesforce adds capacity securely across Regions and accounts while keeping its data residency commitments, and sees per request where each call was served and why.
articles.titleEn: How Salesforce is advancing global-scale model serving with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Why serving these models makes capacity a reliability problem Salesforce’s Agentforce Foundation team serves customers from the Region their requests come from, across 30+ global Regions and hundreds of AWS accounts, and they provision capacity based on each customer’s traffic.

Traffic stays in us-west-2 while the local endpoint is saturated, shifts to us-east-2 once requests begin returning errors (peaking at about 78 percent), then returns gradually to us-west-2 over about 10 minutes after recovery
The team needed a managed, capacity-aware routing path.

localization.title: Salesforce가 Amazon SageMaker AI에서 지역 간 추론 라우팅을 통해 글로벌 규모 모델 서비스를 발전시키는 방법 | 아마존 웹 서비스
summaryLines: 이러한 모델을 제공하면 용량이 안정성 문제가 되는 이유 Salesforce의 Agentforce Foundation 팀은 30개 이상의 글로벌 지역과 수백 개의 AWS 계정에 걸쳐 요청이 발생한 지역의 고객에게 서비스를 제공하고 각 고객의 트래픽을 기반으로 용량을 프로비저닝함
로컬 엔드포인트가 포화된 동안 트래픽은 us-west-2에 유지되고 요청이 오류를 반환하기 시작하면(약 78% 최고) us-east-2로 이동한 다음 복구 후 약 10분에 걸쳐 점차적으로 us-west-2로 돌아옴
팀에는 관리되고 용량을 인식하는 라우팅 경로가 필요함

articles.title: Private certificate authority support in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now supports private certificate authorities (CAs), so your agents can connect to self-hosted identity providers that use a private CA. This post shows how to issue an IdP certificate with AWS Private CA, configure a credential provider to trust it, rotate the CA, and protect the certificate.
articles.titleEn: Private certificate authority support in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: In most Keycloak deployments, the discovery, JWKS, and token endpoints share one hostname.
With private CA support in AgentCore Identity , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, your agents can now connect to these IdPs while trusting the private CA that your organization already uses.
Regions : Private CA support depends on VPC Lattice and is available in the AWS Regions where AgentCore Identity supports private IdPs.

articles.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
articles.descEn: Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon, delivering frontier-level intelligence for complex coding and analysis at a lower cost. See what's new.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
summaryLinesEn: The model is priced at $3 per million input tokens ($0.15 per million cached input tokens, a 95% discount) and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window.

Delivers across enterprise, analytical, and scientific work Brings efficiency and control to production-grade workflows Built for fast, efficient, frontier-level cyber defense Neon ranks ahead of comparable models and #3 overall with a score of 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its xhigh thinking level, landing just behind larger, slower models.

We found that with real-time safeguards at its highest thinking level, Neon resisted every attack within this Gray Swan benchmark, matching the 0.0% attack success rate reached only by other Gemini models.

articles.titleEn: Design responsible AI controls for Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Figure 1: Architecture of RAG-based customer support chatbot with Responsible AI controls on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL An ingestion pipeline loads historical support tickets, FAQs, and product documentation into Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL after redacting PII, using the pgvector and aws_ml extensions for vector operations and Aurora ML integration.

Consider a customer support chatbot built on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL that uses RAG with pgvector embeddings, Amazon Bedrock model inference, and AWS Responsible AI guardrails to deliver grounded, explainable responses.

articles.title: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
articles.descEn: Claude Fable 5.2 has solved two open problems in theoretical physics. Both concern black holes and the search for a theory of quantum gravity.
articles.titleEn: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
summaryLinesEn: He asked Claude to draw up a list of interesting open problems in theoretical physics, specifically focusing on black holes and the bootstrap method.

Bo Sundborg in 1999, and after him Ofer Aharony, Joseph Marsano, Shiraz Minwalla, Kyriakos Papadodimas, and Mark Van Raamsdonk, showed that even at weak coupling, the theory on the rim goes through a transition as it heats up.
Black holes are a natural testing ground, because they’re one of the few areas where both relativity and quantum mechanics matter—they pack immense mass into a very small space.

articles.title: How Airbnb uses cost per task to operate coding agents on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Airbnb runs evals on real engineering tasks and uses Amazon Bedrock observability to choose models for its coding agents and control production costs. This post shows how cost per task guides model selection, why production spending can differ from eval results, and how to monitor latency, manage quotas, and attribute spend.
articles.titleEn: How Airbnb uses cost per task to operate coding agents on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Bedrock also publishes EstimatedTPMQuotaUsage , which measures your estimated tokens per minute (TPM) quota consumption, including cache write tokens and output burndown multipliers, across all inference APIs ( Converse , InvokeModel , ConverseStream , and InvokeModelWithResponseStream ).
As coding agents move into production, changes in models and usage can affect latency, capacity, and cost.
We explain how cost per task guides model selection and how production data helps us revisit those choices as usage changes.

articles.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
articles.descEn: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
articles.titleEn: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
summaryLinesEn: Below, we share an overview of what’s available at each CVP access level, as well as requirements for security and privacy controls: To assess the efficacy of our CVP protections, we ran Claude Opus 5.5 through CyScenarioBench—an evaluation that measures whether models can plan and execute multi-stage cyber operations under realistic constraints—with safeguards tuned for our different CVP tiers.

Frontier Red Team Oct 27, 2026 Discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in critical, real-world software with Claude We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
The changes we’re making to our Cyber Verification Program today are intended to extend the impact of Project Glasswing to a much larger number of cyber defenders.

articles.title: Introducing Unity Gateway Insights | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: When looking to cut AI costs, teams often start with budgets or open-source models. But agent traces can reveal other opportunities to save.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Unity Gateway Insights | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: The $1.2M we found came from just seven small bugs in our MCP servers: $499K in wasted tokens plus 12,000 hours of engineers waiting on agents.

At Databricks, trace analysis surfaced several: offline replays showed no performance gain from upgrading from Opus 4.8 to Opus 5, so we stayed on the cheaper 4.8; fixing common MCP errors recovered an estimated $1.2M in costs a year ; and traces showed that simple prompts were going to expensive models, prompting us to adopt Smart Routing .
If you already have traffic flowing through Unity Gateway, open AI Gateway > Observability > Insights and generate a report for the last day, 7 days, or 30 days.

sourceContent.headline: Introducing workload recovery and expanded infrastructure checks on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Large training jobs can stall or compute wrong results even when every node looks healthy. Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now adds workload recovery and expanded infrastructure checks that catch these failures sooner and raise the goodput of your training workloads.
paragraphs: At the SageMaker HyperPod on-demand price of approximately $66 per instance-hour in US East (N.
Today, we’re introducing workload recovery and infrastructure checks on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod that catch these failures sooner and raise the goodput of your training workloads.
Scheduling goodput is the share of time that all the resources a job needs are available.

Large training jobs can fail even when every node looks healthy. A GPU with a subtle fault can pass its stress tests and still return wrong values. When a job stalls on an NCCL timeout, it keeps its GPUs, and Slurm still shows it as running. If a device plugin crashes on one node, the job fails with an error that never mentions the plugin. Teams usually find these problems only after the loss diverges or the job fails, and by then the compute is spent. Each of these failures lowers goodput, the share of your cluster’s time that goes to useful training. Today, we’re introducing workload recovery and infrastructure checks on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod that catch these failures sooner and raise the goodput of your training workloads.

SageMaker HyperPod already handles nodes that report hardware faults. The health monitoring agent (HMA) watches each node for GPU errors, deep health checks test nodes during provisioning, and automatic node recovery reboots or replaces faulty hardware. These features look at one node’s hardware at a time. They can’t tell whether the GPUs train correctly, whether a job is still making progress, or whether the Kubernetes components a job depends on are working.
In this post, we walk through the three new capabilities that catch these failures. For each one, we show how to set it up and what it reports when it finds a problem:

sourceContent.description: Exa's neural search engine is backed by an in-house vector database, so the unit economics of embedding tens of billions of web documents drive the business. This post shares how Exa optimized embedding inference on AWS Neuron hardware (Inferentia2 and Trainium2) with custom NKI kernels, reaching a 47% gain in performance and cost per million documents.
paragraphs: We selected 30 billion high-priority documents for re-embedding.
In total, our final version was a 47% improvement in performance and cost per 1 million documents embedded, against our initial baseline.
Shifting hardware profiles lets us free up nodes other teams need or absorb their unused reserved compute.

At Exa , we are building one of the few true web indexes by aggregating and serving knowledge from across the web, along with private and synthetic sources. We optimize the index for semantic search, grounding agents and humans in true, high-quality data. We use multi-tower semantic machine learning (ML) models to embed web data and query data into the same vector space, so users can express complex queries in natural language alongside traditional keyword search. The keystone technology behind this is an in-house vector database. It must ingest as much high-quality web data as possible and embed all of it. The unit economics of embedding therefore underlie everything we do. At the scale of tens or hundreds of billions of documents, finding the hardware that delivers the best performance per dollar isn’t a tuning detail. Any per-document cost improvement compounds into a significant number.

This post details how we optimized our embedding infrastructure for cheaper, more flexible inference workloads on AWS Neuron hardware ( AWS Inferentia2 and AWS Trainium2 ), and how an agentic development workflow drove the optimization.
Inference runs on an asynchronous pipeline, but it must be high-volume and fast to serve recent data quickly and shrink the time between discovery and serving.

articles.title: Huawei's Stellar Glow Fades, Honor's Radiance Dims: Key Shifts in China's Smartphone Brand Landscape
articles.descEn: Against the backdrop of its ongoing IPO process, Honor has sparked widespread industry discussions with its frequent cross-sector strategic layouts in recent times. This in-depth analysis explores the core driving forces behind the smartphone giant’s aggressive cross-domain expansion amid its IPO preparation: covering how it breaks through the bottleneck of homogeneous competition in the consumer electronics track, builds a full-scenario smart ecosystem to elevate its pre-IPO valuation logic, locks in long-term growth curves through cross-sector technological synergy, and responds to the new demands of global consumer smart life. The content also sorts out the key layout directions of Honor’s cross-sector moves, providing professional insights for industry insiders, investors and technology followers to grasp Honor’s long-term development strategy beyond the capital market.
articles.titleEn: Huawei's Stellar Glow Fades, Honor's Radiance Dims: Key Shifts in China's Smartphone Brand Landscape
summaryLinesEn: According to Caixin reports, in November 2020, when Shenzhen state-owned capital acquired Honor from Huawei, the transaction price was about 40 billion US dollars (about 260 billion RMB at the exchange rate at that time).

Guided by the Alpha Strategy, Honor has successively launched product lines such as the Magic8, Magic9, and Magic V6 series, and launched AI services including the YOYO intelligent agent family, YOYO Task, and AI call assistant.

According to disclosures by digital blogger "Smart Chip Insider", in the first half of 2026, products in the 0-2000 yuan price range accounted for 49% of Honor's mobile phone sales, only 1 percentage point lower than Xiaomi, which is known for its cost-effective positioning.

articles.title: Mirantis Joins Lenovo AI Innovators to Help Cloud Providers Turn GPU Infrastructure into AI Services
articles.descEn: CAMPBELL, Calif., November 18, 2026--Mirantis, delivering open, standards based infrastructure for the next generation of AI clouds, today announced it has joined the Lenovo AI Innovators program to help cloud providers and enterprises turn Lenovo AI infrastructure into production AI services.
articles.titleEn: Mirantis Joins Lenovo AI Innovators to Help Cloud Providers Turn GPU Infrastructure into AI Services
summaryLinesEn: For cloud providers, these capabilities make GPU capacity faster to deliver and simpler to operate at scale, and provide a foundation to offer additional managed AI services.
For enterprises, the capabilities provide a foundation for private AI environments that give teams access to accelerated computing while maintaining centralized operational control.

"Cloud providers and enterprises are investing in GPUs to deliver services, support developers and build new revenue streams," said Richard Borenstein, senior vice president of business development, Mirantis.

articles.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Could Be 46% Undervalued Following AI Factory Updates
articles.descEn: Dell Technologies (DELL) put its AI story back in focus with fresh upgrades to the Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA, adding new data tools, liquid cooled storage and large scale infrastructure management. Despite the AI Factory updates, Dell Technologies’ recent share price action has cooled. The 30-day share price return is down 28.54% and the 90-day share price return is down 26.23%, while the year-to-date share price return stands at 152.57% and the 1-year total shareholder return reaches...
articles.titleEn: Dell Technologies (DELL) Could Be 46% Undervalued Following AI Factory Updates
summaryLinesEn: Dell Technologies last closed at $322.79, while the analyst consensus Narrative on Simply Wall St estimates fair value at $594.16.

Dell Technologies is experiencing accelerating demand for AI servers and data center solutions as enterprises globally increase investments in AI and machine learning workloads and digital transformation, supported by more than US$130b of AI server orders in the past 12 months, a US$95b AI backlog and a pipeline that is multiples of backlog, which ties directly to future revenue and earnings.
Still, Dell Technologies faces real pressure points if AI server margins remain in the mid single digits or if tight component supply slows the conversion of its large backlog.

Dell Technologies는 지난 12개월 동안 미화 1,300억 달러 이상의 AI 서버 주문, 미화 950억 달러의 AI 백로그 및 향후 수익 및 수익과 직접적으로 연결되는 파이프라인의 지원을 받아 기업이 전 세계적으로 AI 및 머신 러닝 워크로드와 디지털 변혁에 대한 투자를 늘리면서 AI 서버 및 데이터 센터 솔루션에 대한 수요가 가속화되고 있음을 경험하고 있음
그럼에도 불구하고, Dell Technologies는 AI 서버 마진이 한 자릿수 중반에 머물거나 빠듯한 구성 요소 공급으로 인해 대규모 백로그의 전환이 느려지는 경우 실제 압력 포인트에 직면함

Dell Technologies는 지난 12개월 동안 미화 1,300억 달러 이상의 AI 서버 주문, 미화 950억 달러의 AI 백로그 및 향후 수익 및 수익과 직접적으로 연결되는 파이프라인의 지원을 받아 기업이 전 세계적으로 AI 및 머신 러닝 워크로드와 디지털 변혁에 대한 투자를 늘리면서 AI 서버 및 데이터 센터 솔루션에 대한 수요가 가속화되고 있음을 경험하고 있음
그럼에도 불구하고, Dell Technologies는 AI 서버 마진이 한 자릿수 중반에 머물거나 빠듯한 구성 요소 공급으로 인해 대규모 백로그의 전환이 느려지는 경우 실제 압력 포인트에 직면함

articles.title: Replit Launches Replit & Co., a New Creator Program Bringing B2B Voices Into the Era of the Self-Driving Company
articles.descEn: Replit, the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications without learning to code, today announced Replit & Co., a new B2B creator program that brings together business and technology creators to demonstrate how enterprises can build software and put agents to work with Replit. The program supports Replit's vision of the self-driving company, where people define goals and remain accountable while agents execute work within clear boundaries.

summaryLinesEn: Founded in 2016, the company has more than 60 million users worldwide, including users at 85% of the Fortune 500.

Replit & Co. launched with 45 creators, including Marina Mogilko, known as "Silicon Valley Girl"; April Little, named to the 2025 TIME100 Creators list; and Carly Taylor, engineering leader and founder of Rebel Data Science.

articles.descEn: OneTrust's Fall '26 Release expands AI visibility, privacy and third-party risk tools - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: OneTrust's Fall '26 Release expands AI visibility, privacy and third-party risk tools - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: OneTrust has raised $1.13 billion to date, including $150 million in 2023 at a valuation of $4.5 billion.

Drawing on previous assessments and supplier documentation, the company’s expanded AI Document Scanning and Inventory Response Analysis features can now also answer questions about the business engagement tied to a third party.

Building on OneTrust CORIE , a shared intelligence layer for governing artificial intelligence agents introduced at the company’s TrustWeek conference in September, the release covers AI visibility, privacy, consent and third-party risk management.

articles.title: Mistral plays catch-up with Vibe Desktop as rivals already command full operating systems
articles.descEn: Mistral's AI agent Vibe now has its own desktop app.
articles.titleEn: Mistral plays catch-up with Vibe Desktop as rivals already command full operating systems
summaryLinesEn: The agent can work either in a local repository or in a cloud sandbox, and the app uses Git worktrees to keep parallel tasks in the same project separate.

Mistral caught up on the model side in October with Large 4 , but in head-to-head comparisons it still trails Gemini 4 Carbon and Claude Opus 5.5 by a wide margin and also falls behind the strongest open models from China.
Mistral's AI agent Vibe now has its own desktop app.

articles.title: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents
articles.descEn: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents Microsoft Source
articles.titleEn: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents

articles.title: Build WhatsApp AI agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: SMART, an open-source Python SDK and Terraform stack, deploys the full WhatsApp channel layer to your AWS account with one command. Bring any agent that runs on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and SMART handles webhook ingestion, media, conversation memory, scheduling, and Meta message templates.
articles.titleEn: Build WhatsApp AI agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Supporting services such as Amazon DynamoDB (optional, for per-user state), AWS Secrets Manager, Amazon CloudWatch, and Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) supply state management, credentials, monitoring, and storage across the stack.
Inbound messages arrive as deeply nested, type-dependent payloads that must be authenticated and normalized before your agent can read them.
Wiring that up means configuring more than 10 AWS services and learning a set of WhatsApp system behaviors that most teams discover only by hitting them.

articles.title: Is Broadcom (AVGO) Undervalued After Strong AI Revenue Growth And ETF Buying?
articles.descEn: Broadcom (AVGO) has been in focus after a sharp pickup in AI chip revenue and fresh projections for its custom accelerators and networking gear, helped by investor rotation following Nvidia’s leadership change. Over the past year, Broadcom has swung between enthusiasm for its AI story and concern about financing risk, with a 90 day share price return that declined 12.26% and a 1 year total shareholder return that slipped 1.98% even as long term holders still sit on a roughly 5.6x five year...

summaryLinesEn: Broadcom (AVGO) has been in focus after a sharp pickup in AI chip revenue and fresh projections for its custom accelerators and networking gear, helped by investor rotation following Nvidia's leadership change.

Whether data is generated by AI models, cloud applications, enterprise software, autonomous systems, or future technologies that do not yet exist, that data must still be processed, moved, connected, secured, and managed.

articles.titleEn: Broadcom Inc. (AVGO)’s AI Business Is Fueling Its Next Phase of Long-Term Growth
summaryLinesEn: We just published our list, Ken Fisher Portfolio Review: 10 Highest-Conviction Technology Stocks for Long-Term Growth , and Broadcom Inc. ranked 8th on this list.

articles.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang's exit
articles.descEn: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang's exit
summaryLinesEn: Kress also spoke about Nvidia’s plans for Hugging Face, a platform for open source AI models that the company agreed to acquire for $12.9 billion in September, in what would be the second-largest acquisition in Nvidia’s history.
She also noted that open models were accelerating AI adoption, citing a 35-fold year-over-year surge in weekly token volume on OpenRouter, including a 3.5-fold increase over the past three months.
Correction: Due to a typo, an earlier version of this article incorrectly stated the number of developers served by Hugging Face; it is 18 million, not 118 million.

articles.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
articles.descEn: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.
articles.titleEn: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
summaryLinesEn: Tasks was initially launched to select testers back in May as Gemini Spark, a 24/7 agentic helper, and was expanded to U.S. subscribers of its Google AI Ultra tier.
Users merely flip a toggle within the app from Chat to Tasks, which enables the feature.

Unlike Gemini’s Chat, which merely allows users to talk to Google’s AI assistant for informational purposes, Tasks empowers the app to complete basic secretarial functions, deputizing it as a kind of personal assistant.

articles.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
articles.descEn: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, two new models that are more capable and cheaper than their predecessors. In the independent Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Astra ranks second behind Claude Fable 5.2, and it is the first released model to reach the High threshold for AI self-improvement on OpenAI's own scale. OpenAI itself classifies that as a risk.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
summaryLinesEn: On the internal GDPval-v2 benchmark, which includes consulting, finance, and design tasks, OpenAI says Astra gains 6.2 percentage points over its predecessor while using 22 percent fewer output tokens.
On the coding benchmark FrontierCode 2.0, which checks whether code changes meet the quality bar of real projects, Sol trails Astra by just 0.5 points at one-fifth the cost.

On Agents' Last Exam, a benchmark that tests multi-step professional workflows, GPT-6.2 Astra scores 5.2 points above its predecessor GPT-6 Astra at less than a third of the cost, according to OpenAI.

sourceContent.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
sourceContent.description: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, two new models that are more capable and cheaper than their predecessors. In the independent Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Astra ranks second behind Claude Fable 5.2, and it is the first released model to reach the High threshold for AI self-improvement on OpenAI's own scale. OpenAI itself classifies that as a risk.
paragraphs: On the internal GDPval-v2 benchmark, which includes consulting, finance, and design tasks, OpenAI says Astra gains 6.2 percentage points over its predecessor while using 22 percent fewer output tokens.
On the coding benchmark FrontierCode 2.0, which checks whether code changes meet the quality bar of real projects, Sol trails Astra by just 0.5 points at one-fifth the cost.

On Agents' Last Exam, a benchmark that tests multi-step professional workflows, GPT-6.2 Astra scores 5.2 points above its predecessor GPT-6 Astra at less than a third of the cost, according to OpenAI.

summaryLines: OpenAI는 컨설팅, 재무 및 설계 작업을 포함하는 내부 GDPval-v2 벤치마크에서 Astra가 이전 제품보다 6.2% 포인트를 얻으면서 출력 토큰을 22% 더 적게 사용한다고 밝힘

OpenAI에 따르면 다단계 전문 워크플로우를 테스트하는 벤치마크인 Agents' Last Exam에서 GPT-6.2 Astra는 3분의 1 미만의 비용으로 이전 GPT-6 Astra보다 5.2점을 획득함

articles.title: Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?
articles.descEn: The French CEO of Hugging Face, a mega-hub of open-source AI software, says the attack by OpenAI models earlier this year proved one thing: Humanity can’t let AI be controlled by the few.
articles.titleEn: Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?
summaryLinesEn: Clément Delangue, CEO of the open-source AI company Hugging Face , may go down in history as one of the first people ever attacked by a rogue AI agent.
Delangue moved to the US more than a decade ago, “barely speaking English,” and built Hugging Face into a platform that supports tens of millions of AI developers.
Despite championing the democratization of AI, however, Hugging Face was acquired by one of the industry’s biggest players, Nvidia, for $12.93 billion in September.

articles.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: GPT-6.2 Astra comes less than two months after OpenAI called off the planned October release of GPT-6.1 Astra, after internal testing found the model fell short on staying within scope and authorization.
The decision was announced the day before the company’s DevDay event in September, where GPT-6.1 Sol launched on its own.

Like GPT-6 Astra, both GPT-6.2 models meet the Critical threshold for cybersecurity under OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework, and their increased capabilities have led the company to launch them with tighter safeguards for higher-risk cybersecurity assistance that are also said to restrict some legitimate vulnerability research.

summaryLines: GPT-6.2 Astra는 OpenAI가 GPT-6.1 Astra의 10월 릴리스 계획을 취소한 지 두 달도 채 안 되어 출시됨 · 내부 테스트 결과 해당 모델이 범위와 승인 범위를 벗어나지 못하는 것으로 나타남
이 결정은 GPT-6.1 Sol이 자체적으로 출시된 9월 DevDay 행사 전날 발표됨

articles.title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
articles.descEn: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.
articles.titleEn: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
summaryLinesEn: On Tuesday, Pedestal AI emerged from stealth with $4.7 million in seed funding.
The supply chain startup Atomic , launched by a team of Tesla alumni, came out of stealth in 2025 with an emphasis on streamlining inventory.
Pedestal says the funding will be used to expand its product and engineering time, grow the marketing organization, and support additional deployments.
